summary: Helio Corp filed an 8-K reporting a debt-for-equity exchange with its CTO Gregory Delory. $327,629 in promissory notes were cancelled in exchange for 149,979 shares of common stock, issued at a conversion price of $2.1845 (20-day VWAP). The issuance was made under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act as an exchange exempt from registration. The transaction is a routine debt conversion with no premium, tender, or outside involvement; it is not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors were mentioned. The filing cures a related off-balance-sheet obligation. Monitor for future registration of the restricted shares.
